design_brief.aesthetic: Dense operational cockpit with editorial hierarchy: graphite surfaces, mint status signals, cyan interactive focus, crisp ledger rhythm, and restrained industrial detail.
design_brief.colors: graphite #111716, charcoal #1A2220, mist #EAF2EF, muted sage #9FB0AA, mint #52E0A4, cyan #43C9E8, amber #F4C56A, coral #FF7D72
design_brief.hero_element: A large live KPI number at the top of each tab, led on Applications by Today Applied in Chicago time, with supporting totals immediately beneath it.
design_brief.moment: A job-application operator opens the dashboard between automation runs to see today’s throughput, resolve blockers, and inspect the exact ledger behind every number.
design_brief.typography: IBM Plex Sans for interface and data, ui-monospace for identifiers, hashes, and compact ledger metadata.
